free.name: Free
free.blurb: A simple invitation from the free templates, with a minimal reply form. No seating chart.

standard.name: Standard
standard.blurb: Any simple template, with a minimal reply form and a seating chart.
standard.upsell: Opens every simple template and adds a seating chart. You pay the difference, and nothing you have written is lost.

custom.name: Custom
custom.blurb: Every template, simple or modular: your own sections, reply questions, palette, fonts and images. Seating chart included.
custom.upsell: Unlocks modular templates with your own sections, reply questions, palette and fonts. You pay the difference, and nothing you have written is lost.

EventPage.repliesClosingBody: The reply form closes on {date}, {custom, select, yes {the time you set} other {the day before the event}}.
EventPage.repliesClosedBody: The reply form closed on {date}. You can still add replies that reach you in any other way.
EventPage.unpaidBody: The {package} package costs {price}. The page stays hidden and the reply form stays closed until payment clears.
EventPage.hiddenPaidBody: It's paid for, but set to Hidden: nobody can open it, not even a guest with the link.
EventPage.deletingBody: The invitation and every reply are deleted on {date}. Export them first if you want to keep them.
EventPage.attentionBody: Unknown or repeated names. Sort them out at the top of Guests.
EventPage.pausedBody: Far more replies than expected, so the form is paused. Real guests? Raise the number. If not, report it.

EventEditor.leaveUnsaved: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
EventEditor.eventNameHint: The only place a guest meets it is the browser tab title.
EventEditor.languageHint: What your guests read — the reply form, Festio's own wording, and the date. It has nothing to do with the language you read Festio in.
EventEditor.dateHint: The date of your event, and the one shown on the invitation.
EventEditor.dateLockedHint: The event day has come, so the date can no longer change.
EventEditor.languageWarning: Guests who open your link from now on will find the reply form in the new language. Replies already sent are unaffected — they are stored against the question, not its wording. A printable you have already downloaded keeps the language it was made in; download it again to get the new one.
EventEditor.dateWarning: Your invitation will show the new date, but Festio will not tell your guests — that part is yours to do. {count, plural, =0 {No one has replied for this event yet.} one {# guest has already replied for this event.} other {# guests have already replied for this event.}}
EventEditor.closeTooLate: Pick a time no later than the 24-hour cut-off.
EventEditor.expectedTooLow: {count, plural, one {You already have # reply.} other {You already have # replies.}} You can't expect fewer guests than have already replied.
EventEditor.expectedRequired: Enter how many guests you expect.
EventEditor.slugTooShort: Use at least {min} characters — letters, digits and hyphens.
EventEditor.slugReserved: This word is reserved by Festio. Try another.
EventEditor.passwordInvalid: Use at least 4 letters or digits.
EventEditor.addressHint: If you have already shared the link, changing it will break every copy your guests are holding.
EventEditor.addressWarning: The old link stops working the moment you save. Every copy your {count, plural, one {# guest is holding} other {# guests are holding}} leads nowhere, and passing on the new one is yours to do.
EventEditor.passwordWarning: The old password stops working the moment you save. Guests will not be able to see the invitation until you give them the new one.
EventEditor.noindex: Never shown on Google or other search engines, whatever you pick.
EventEditor.expectedHint: We use this to show how your replies are coming in. You can raise the number anytime.
EventEditor.payNote: Clears the draft for sharing. Visibility stays where you set it until you change it yourself.
EventEditor.deletedBody: The invitation, every reply and any image you uploaded go automatically, {days} days after {date}. Your account is not affected.
EventEditor.deletedBodyPast: The invitation, every reply and any image you uploaded went automatically, {days} days after {date}. Your account is not affected.
EventEditor.keepTitle: Save what you want to keep
EventEditor.keepBody: Export your guests, every reply, your seating chart and the printable invitation before then. Once the record is deleted it is gone from Festio for good — we have no way to bring it back.
EventEditor.keepBodyPast: Anything not exported before that date is gone from Festio for good — we have no way to bring it back.
EventEditor.controller: Festio only processes this event's data for you, under the <link>DPA in the Terms</link>. What your guests tell you is theirs: use it to run this event and nothing else, never sell it or pass it to anyone who is not helping you host, and keep any copy you download to yourself.
EventEditor.told: The reply form names you as the person responsible for their details, and says what is collected and how long it is kept.
EventEditor.pastBody: The record is deleted on its own on {date}, or you can delete it now. Export anything you want to keep first — once deleted, it is gone for good.
EventEditor.paidDeleteBody: A paid event can't be deleted before it happens. Cancel it first.
EventEditor.cancelBody: Closes the reply form and replaces the invitation with a short message from you. {count, plural, =0 {No guest has replied yet.} one {# guest has already replied and will not be notified.} other {# guests have already replied and none of them will be notified.}} Guest and event data are kept for another {days} days, and you can reopen the event at any point in that window.
EventEditor.cancelled: Event cancelled — the invitation now shows your message
EventEditor.cancelledBody: Guests see your message in place of the invitation and can no longer reply. The record is deleted on its own on {date}, or you can delete it now. Export anything you want to keep first — once deleted, it is gone for good.
EventEditor.draftBody: Nobody has seen this page and nothing has been paid for, so it can be removed outright. This can't be undone.
EventEditor.draftConfirm: Are you sure? The draft is deleted for good.
EventEditor.acknowledge: I understand — telling my guests is up to me.
EventEditor.saved: Changes saved — your guests were not notified
EventEditor.noListHint: Add the names you expect and Festio will flag any reply that doesn't match one.
EventEditor.matchedNoList: Replies aren't matched against an invite list.
EventEditor.matchedList: Replies are matched against your invite list.
EventEditor.listNow: {count, plural, one {Your invite list has # name right now.} other {Your invite list has # names right now.}} You can change it on the Guests page.
EventEditor.passwordHint: Printed on the card, right under the link.
EventEditor.readClosesDefault: The day before the event, by default.
EventEditor.occasionHint: Helps Festio suggest the templates that suit your event.
EventEditor.listSwitch: Match replies against an invite list
EventEditor.cancelMessagePlaceholder: For example: We're sorry, the party is cancelled. Thank you for understanding.
EventEditor.cancelMessageHint: Guests who open the link see the event's header and this message instead of the invitation. Up to {max} characters.
EventEditor.confirmPasswordHint: Your Festio account password, to confirm it's you.

HostEditor.testReply: Nothing saved — this is a test

PrintPanel.tinted: Use matching color for the back and inside of the card.

flat: You will download two images: one for the front, one for the back.
Print them on the two sides of a single sheet of paper — nothing to fold.
Paper size: anything between A6 (smallest recommended) and A5 (largest recommended), as long as you keep the A-series proportions.
folded: You will download two images: one for each side of the sheet.
Print them on the two sides of a single sheet, then fold it in half — the front of the invitation ends up on the outside.
Paper size before folding: anything between A5 (smallest recommended) and A4 (largest recommended), as long as you keep the A-series proportions.
